description: Lab telemetry reporter — combines localweb2 (hardware, network, weather) and nPM service state (via localweb proxy) into one compact read-only report. No control actions.

tools.name: telemetry_report
tools.description: Fetch a combined lab telemetry report from localweb2: environment heartbeat (active PCs, WAN traffic, latency, router CPU, weather), per-PC hardware stats (CPU/GPU load, temps, power, RAM, disks), active alerts, cluster power/thermal summary, service states with LLM health findings. Read-only. Log tails are stripped to keep the report compact. Optional sections parameter to limit scope.

sections.description: Optional subset of sections to include. Default: all four.
